profile.summary: Lu Hongcheng (Chris Lu) is a Ph.D. student in Journalism and Communication at Tsinghua University, with graduation expected in 2027. His research focuses on human–machine communication, economic communication, and international communication. He has published 11 articles (2 SSCI, 6 CSSCI, and 2 CSSCI Expanded), including 4 as first author, with work in Feminist Media Studies, Sexualities, Chinese Journal of Journalism & Communication, and Modern Communication; 2 further works are forthcoming. He has presented at AEJMC, ICA, IAMCR, and NCA and received the 2026 AEJMC CTEC Top Student Paper award.
profile.summary_zh: 陆泓承，清华大学新闻与传播学院博士研究生，预计2027年毕业。研究聚焦人机传播、经济传播与国际传播。已发表论文11篇（SSCI 2篇、CSSCI 6篇、CSSCI扩展版2篇），其中第一作者论文4篇，成果见于 Feminist Media Studies、Sexualities、《国际新闻界》《现代传播》等期刊，另有2项成果待刊。研究曾在AEJMC、ICA、IAMCR、NCA国际传播学会议报告，获2026年AEJMC传播技术分会最佳学生论文。

themes.name: Human–machine communication
themes.text_zh: 关注人与人工智能的互动及其传播后果，研究人机协作、AI新闻学、认知让渡、批判性思维与虚假信息易感性，并考察信息与平台治理及国家科技形象等相关议题。
themes.text: This research examines human–AI interaction and its consequences for communication, including human–AI collaboration, AI journalism, cognitive offloading, critical thinking, and vulnerability to misinformation. Related interests include information and platform governance and national technological images.

themes.name: Economic communication
themes.text_zh: 关注经济信息的生产、传播与公众理解，研究财经新闻、人机协作、经济叙事与传播效果。政策传播是其中一个具体研究场景，并与中国经济国际传播相衔接，考察新闻如何影响公众认知、信心与预期。
themes.text: This research examines the production, circulation, and public understanding of economic information, focusing on financial journalism, human–AI collaboration, economic narratives, and communication effects. Policy communication provides one empirical context, alongside the international communication of China’s economy, for studying public perceptions, confidence, and expectations.

themes.name: International communication
themes.text_zh: 关注企业出海与中国经济国际传播，研究跨文化语境中的经济叙事、国家经济与科技形象，以及平台与信息治理。结合经济传播视角，考察中国企业、经济议题与数字平台如何被国际媒体和公众理解。
themes.text: This research focuses on Chinese companies’ international expansion and the international communication of China’s economy. It examines economic narratives across cultures, national economic and technological images, and platform and information governance, asking how international media and publics understand Chinese companies, economic issues, and digital platforms.

products.title: Central Economic Work Conference Yearbook
products.tagline: A year-by-year reading of China's Central Economic Work Conference communiqués since 1994.
products.tagline_zh: 1994年以来中央经济工作会议通稿的逐年解读：每年有哪些新提法，先部署什么，政策怎么定调。
highlights: New formulations: 101 hand-curated new policy phrases, traced to first use, uptake in the next Government Work Report, and later reuse.
Priorities: the order of key tasks each year, grouped into policy areas, plus fiscal and monetary stance since 1994.
Information ideas: how the conference talks about expectations, confidence, public opinion and communication.
Full-text search across all communiqués; updated after each December conference.
highlights_zh: 新提法：101个人工精选提法，可追溯首次出现、是否写入次年政府工作报告及此后沿用情况。
部署顺序：每年重点任务的先后与所属领域，以及1994年以来财政、货币政策定调的变化。
信息观念：会议怎样谈论预期、信心、舆论与政策传播。
全部通稿可按句检索；每年12月会议结束后更新。
